Done. The fix is complete and validated.

**Root cause:** In the page reverse index used for short-name lookups like `site.GetPage "p2"` (`hugolib/content_map_page.go:933`), only pages backed by content files were indexed, keyed by `p.File().FileInfo().Meta().PathInfo.BaseNameNoIdentifier()`. Pages created by content adapters have `File()` pointing at the `_content.gotmpl` template, whose `PathInfo` resolves to the container directory (`s2`) instead of the page name (`p2`), so adapter pages were never indexed under their own name.

**Fix** (`hugolib/content_map_page.go`): index each page by its own `PathInfo().BaseNameNoIdentifier()`, falling back to the file's `PathInfo` only when the page has none, and skipping empty names (e.g. home). This preserves existing behavior for file-backed pages and makes adapter pages resolvable by short name.

- `TestGetPageContentAdapterBaseIssue12561` (the FAIL_TO_PASS case) now passes.
